subject.title: [Bug]: In msteams channel messages, OpenClaw can't access inbound attachments

question: Should the canonical Teams inbound attachment fix land as the broader no-new-config channel repair, a default-off graphMediaFallback setting, or a combined/narrowed PR?
rationale: Current main and the latest release remain broken, but the two open closing PRs encode different operator and compatibility tradeoffs for when Teams text/html stubs should trigger Graph media lookup.

options.title: Use the broader channel repair
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90738 as the canonical path because it covers the channel team GUID, fallback trigger, and thread-reply URL root causes with sufficient proof.

options.title: Require default-off config
options.body: Ask contributors to converge on a config-gated implementation if maintainers prefer preserving the current fallback behavior unless operators opt in.

options.title: Split group-chat follow-up
options.body: Land the channel root-cause repair first and keep group-chat-only config or docs refinements as a separate follow-up if needed.

recommendation.title: Use the broader channel repair
recommendation.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90738 as the canonical path because it covers the channel team GUID, fallback trigger, and thread-reply URL root causes with sufficient proof.

likelyOwner.reason: CODEOWNERS and feature-history evidence make this the strongest available owner for the config and plugin-boundary product choice.
